note: feature_list is glue/human-owned. Parallel track agents must not race writes; use PR notes or ask glue.

features.title: Go api: POST /process + rate limit + forward
features.scope: Validate body, token bucket ~1500, forward to compute, 422/429/502/504, /app/health, logs without payload.
verification: cd api && go test ./... && go vet ./...
features.notes: Track A. No Redis in api.

features.title: Rust structural detectors + checksums
features.scope: Passport, VU, INN, phone, email, card+Luhn, CVV, PIN, dates with markers, postal, department; NER/dict FIO/address; context FP; merge + PIN gate.
acceptance_criteria: All TZ structural types detected case-insensitively
Pushkin / bank branch not masked without structural context
Bare date not PII; birth/issue date with marker is
verification: cd compute && cargo test test_structural test_ner test_context test_merge

features.title: Etalon-style partial masks
features.scope: Per-type partial masks matching checker etalon style; right-to-left apply. FPE/synthetic stubs only.
acceptance_criteria: Masks match etalon style on fixture set
No FPE on hot path until must green

features.title: Correspondence vault + demask roundtrip
features.scope: payload_id vault; AES-GCM; sync put before 200; lookup without detect semaphore; TTL 86400.
acceptance_criteria: Demask path does not take detect semaphore

features.title: Pipeline wiring, /stats, compose, selfcheck
features.scope: Glue A–D; mean/p50/p95/p99; mask_ok/demask_ok; compose; selfcheck; load jury; pack.sh; README ≤5 sentences.
features.notes: Starts after A–D. Only owner of feature_list writes.

features.title: Clippy/vet + zip quality gate
features.scope: clippy -D warnings, go vet, no todo! on /process path, pack source-only zip.
acceptance_criteria: zip has no target/, .git, binaries, datasets
verification: cd compute && cargo clippy -- -D warnings && cargo fmt --check

features.title: Bonus: FPE FF1 / synthetic / RPS 2000
features.scope: After must: FF1 (not FF3), synthetic faker, optional 2000 RPS demo.
